messages:
tess: Heads up — ap-southeast GPU warm pool didn't scale up after the midnight rollout, new nodes stuck Pending with KMS grant errors.
ops-bot: deploy: firewall/apac-tighten rolled by kelly at 2026-05-10T00:05Z (change-id ch_20260510_fw_apac_4) :warning:
tess: from node-init: ```2026-05-10T00:09:02Z keystore-proxy: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: "KMSGrantMissing: grant not found for requester"
callstack: node-init -> keystore-proxy -> privatelink-apac -> kms-apac```
omar: looks like the fw change removed the ephemeral NAT path and restricted privatelink CIDR range to control plane. keystore endpoint sits in a different privatelink subnet (10.9.1.0/28) that wasn't included.
pat: also noticed an IAM boundary tweak last week — role condition now includes `aws:SourceVPC` which might exclude ephemeral joiners if their ENIs are not in the expected VPC. could be a two-factor problem.
kelly: immediate options: 1) add temporary fw allow for 10.9.1.0/28 -> 443 for keystore service 2) re-enable NAT for ephem tag 3) relax IAM sourceVPC condition for node-init role 4) provision via fallback region (high egress/latency).
tess: prefer (1) + TTL and runbook entry. (3) is riskier from least-privilege POV.
sec-bot: Exception policy: require owner, TTL <= 4h, audit tag, KMS grant log export, notify compliance, and include KMS key id in ticket.
omar: I'll scope a minimal fw exception: allow 10.9.1.0/28->443 for service keystore-proxy, TTL 120m, tag `keystore-apac-emerg-20260510`.
pat: add monitoring: keystore.decrypt_ok{region="ap-southeast"} and gpu.pool.warm.count. alert if decrypt_ok < 0.9 for 2m or warm.count < target.
ops-bot: policy-exception #8201 created by omar (expires 2026-05-10T02:25Z).
kelly: quick checks from bastion: ```$ curl -sS https://keystore-apac.privatelink.redwood.internal/health
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# TLS ok, but KMS grant denied during key unwrap prior to exception```
omar: exception rolled, initiating warm-pool reconcile now.
tess: new node logs: `keystore: decrypt ok key=arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast:...:key/ef12` — warm pool progressing.
pat: decrypt_ok metric rose to 0.98, warm_pool hit target. good.
kelly: cost tradeoffs quick note: NAT allowance increases monthly egress spend (estimate ~ $320/mo) and increases audit volume. Per-service privatelink endpoints per region ~ $700+/mo plus ops. Relaxing IAM boundary risks compliance. Fallback region onboarding cost variable, could be $100-500 per big spike.
sec-bot: Reminder: attach KMS grant audit logs and IAM policy diff to the incident record. Compliance will want reasoning for TTL.
pat: long-term fix proposals: A) CI firewall preflight that simulates keystore grant flow B) enforce privatelink ownership map in infra repo & policy tests C) per-service endpoint for keystore in APAC if frequency warrants.
tess: I'll own the postmortem. runtime fix owner @omar. security sign-off @kelly.
ops-bot: exception auto-removes at 2026-05-10T02:25Z unless extended.
tess: thanks, will follow up with PM and cost memo.
